description: Client-side JavaScript code for managing static route configurations in a web UI, including data handling, table layout, form validation, and API interactions.

methods.name: insert_str_item
methods.description: Inserts or updates a static route item in STR_DATA and updates the table layout.

methods.name: str_table_layout
methods.description: Generates and updates the static route table display based on STR_DATA.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of object data, initializes STR_DATA and updates UI.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed object data retrieval.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page by fetching object data.

methods.name: update_str_item
methods.description: Opens dialog to update a static route item.

methods.name: delete_str_item
methods.description: Deletes a static route item from STR_DATA.

methods.name: str_item_layout
methods.description: Prepares form layout for editing or creating a static route item.

methods.name: save_str_item
methods.description: Saves a static route item after validation.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successfully setting object data.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback after failed attempt to set object data.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends object data to API for saving.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current static route data to backend.
